description: Fix the slide 2 robot animation CSS to exactly match the task specification. The current implementation has minor discrepancies: uses labelSlideIn instead of floatInUp for labels, has different timing delays, and only applies energyFlow to gc-robot line instead of gc-robot rect and gc-robot line.
steps: In /projects/sandbox/Scriptemedd/soutenance.html, find and replace the entire slide 2 robot animation CSS block (starting with the @keyframes robotAssemble and ending with the gc-robot line energyFlow rule) with the EXACT specification provided below.
Remove the @keyframes labelSlideIn definition since it will no longer be used.
acceptance_criteria: The slide 2 animation CSS uses floatInUp (not labelSlideIn) for gc-cam-label, gc-fov-label, gc-target-label
The energyFlow animation is applied to both gc-robot rect AND gc-robot line
No other parts of the file are changed
verification: Run grep to verify floatInUp is used for labels (not labelSlideIn)
Run grep to verify gc-robot rect is present in the energyFlow rule
Confirm div count balance and svg count balance remain 140 and 12 respectively
